findings.text: `_FakeGraphClient` duplicates `RecordingGraphClient` in tests/recording_graph_client.py:21, which documents the identical capability (`calls` holds one (cypher, params) pair per query, the answer is an empty list) and is imported by eight suites; `_FakeServices.GraphClient` could return that owner instead of a second recorder.

the parameter assertions at lines 89, 90 and 93 compare the values the test itself passed in (sn_id, token, error_msg) against what the marker handed back, so they hold for any passthrough implementation and cannot fail on a wrong value; the statement-substring assertions above them carry the guard.
`_marker(**kwargs)` accepts keyword arguments and silently discards them, so a caller passing a misspelled or unwanted argument sees it vanish instead of raising.
